data.one_liner: A marquee widget for animating looping through widgets horizontally.
data.what_it_does: A marquee widget that loops content seamlessly in a continuous animation. The marquee will only animate if the content contained in the widget extends past the horizontal edge of the screen.
use_when: You need to display scrolling text or widgets horizontally when they exceed screen width.
You want a continuous looping animation for horizontal content.
avoid_when: You need the elements being displayed to be interactable during the animation.
strengths: Seamless looping animation for horizontal content.
Provides customizable parameters like delay, duration, gap, and pause.
weaknesses: Elements being displayed are not interactable during the animation.
data.minimal_example:
Container(
    margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
    child: Marquee(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 5000),
        child: Text('Very long text that bleeds out of the rendering space'),
    },
),
